meta.title: Contact Us & Store Location — The Leather Store
meta.description: Visit The Leather Store, call us or message us on WhatsApp. Find our address on the map, see opening hours and read about the people behind the counter.

head.eyebrow: We are a real shop, with real people
head.title: Come and say hello
head.text: Find us on {STREET} in {CITY}, right opposite Masjid-e-Rehmania. Call ahead, message us on WhatsApp, or simply walk in — someone will always be at the counter.

cta.label: Message us
cta.whatsappMessage: Hello {STORE}! I would like to visit the store.

bio.title: The person who picks every piece

form.title: Ask us anything
form.text: Looking for a specific size, colour or model? Planning a corporate gift order? Tell us what you need and we will reply from the shop, usually within a couple of hours.
form.privacyNote: We never share your details, and nothing typed here is stored on this website.
form.footnote: This form opens WhatsApp with your message ready to send — nothing is stored on this website. Prefer email? Write to
topics: Something specific you are hunting for

phone.label: Phone / WhatsApp
phone.error: Enter a valid phone number (8–15 digits).

email.label: Email (optional)
email.error: That email address does not look right.

message.label: Your message
message.placeholder: Tell us what you are looking for — size, colour, budget, anything helps.
message.error: Please add a few more details (at least 10 characters).

items.title: Checked by hand
items.text: Nothing reaches the shelf without being inspected first. If something is not right, bring it and the bill back to the counter.

items.title: 7-day exchange
items.text: Unused, unworn items in original packaging can be exchanged within 7 days. Fragrances must be sealed.

items.title: Free fitting & alteration
items.text: Shoe stretching, watch strap sizing and frame adjustment are free for life on anything bought here.

items.title: Gift wrapping
items.text: Complimentary on every purchase — just tell us at the counter and we will box it up properly.

items.title: Local delivery
items.text: Free within {CITY} on orders above ₹5,000. Ask us on WhatsApp.

items.title: Transparent pricing
items.text: The price on the tag is the price you pay. All taxes included, no hidden charges.
